query: Run /blueprint check on the attached approved architecture baseline and release candidate. Cite the evidence you use and return a conformance verdict.
expected_behavior: Treats the approved blueprint as the conformance baseline and cites the violated rules
Identifies the approved blueprint version or revision so the verdict is reproducible
Confirms recorded human approval evidence and identifies the exact release-candidate revision or content digest
Cites both attached artifact paths or specific evidence locations from them
Identifies browser-owned eligibility, direct provider access, and queue-equals-delivery as three distinct boundary violations
Traces the affected decision, state, side effect, failure path, and verification gap
Ranks findings by consequence and blast radius rather than by style
Returns a clear non-conforming or blocked verdict with the smallest safe correction path
Does not rewrite the blueprint to make the release pass
